text:
Elena Park: Quick announcement — we're running a 6-week Interview Ops pilot for Runtime hiring to reduce scheduling friction and improve interviewer consistency. Pilot starts Mon.
Marcus Li: Nice. What's changing day-to-day for hiring managers?
Elena Park: Short answer: less calendar juggling. Longer: we'll centralize panel scheduling, set a standard 90-min loop template, and provide a short interviewer rubric + training. Hiring managers still own role bar & final decision.
Samir Patel: I'll run the interviewer training sessions (30m), focus on bias reduction and ops cases. Schedule wise: two sessions next Wed/Thu.
Zoe Kim: Recruiter update: I'm the hiring lead running the pilot. I'll take over scheduling for all Runtime technical loops during the pilot. Please flag any candidate VIPs that need special windows.
Tomas Rivera: I'll sync the tracker and add a new column for "Interview Ops Pilot" so we can compare time-to-offer. Will share a dashboard widget by EOD Fri.
Marcus Li: Any impact to current reqs? Will this delay interviews for people already in flight?
Zoe Kim: No delays intended. For in-flight candidates we'll migrate scheduling to the pilot and notify candidates with a short note. If candidates request existing slots, we honor them.
Elena Park: Ops checklist: 1) Standard loop = screen (30m) + tech deep-dive (60m) + hiring manager wrap (30m). 2) Panel composition doc posted in #people-ops. 3) Use the shared rubric for scorecards.
Samir Patel: I'll post the training slide deck and a 10-min mock question bank after the first session.
Marcus Li: Who covers interview calibration for cross-functional panels (product/infra)?
Elena Park: Good Q. We'll run a calibration panel on Fri 2pm for cross-func leads. Please RSVP if you plan to interview.
Zoe Kim: Recruiter logistics: please add the hiring bar + 3 top outcomes for your role in a comment so I can tailor outreach and the role-specific rubric.
Tomas Rivera: Metric goals for pilot: reduce average schedule cycles from 5 -> 2, and improve interviewer coverage for prime windows (9-11am PST). We'll track candidate NPS too.
Elena Park: Backfill note: People Ops coordinator, hiring coordinator function will be posted today for a 4-week loop. Hiring manager for that req is People Ops (me). Referrals welcome.
Samir Patel: If workflow changes create extra reviewer load, we can add a rotating "interview float" from Runtime for 1 month.
Marcus Li: Sounds reasonable. Any compensation/level changes for folks taking temporary scheduling duties?
Elena Park: No automatic comp changes. Temporary duties are expected as part of normal cross-team support. People Ops will consult if scope shifts materially.
Zoe Kim: I'll post the job and the pilot FAQ in #jobs in ~20m. Please drop referrals or DM me.
Elena Park: Thanks team — small pilot, big upside. I'll do a short kickoff doc and a 15-min Q&A Tue 4pm. Please add questions here. :party_popper:
